head: bcaf7a2538a10176c89dd1fddddafbe29826b56e
scope: Opt-in existing MangoHud per-frame log ->shared cache/IPC/LCD and explicit Mini source picker. Synthetic files, MockBackend, private Qt/GJS/GTK sessions only. No real game, injection/logging activation, system install, production daemon, physical HID or active desktop changes.

primary_sources.windows: Frozen HWiNFOFrameratePresentedAvgSensorManager selects first PresentMon Framerate Presented (avg) DefaultId; SystemInformation publishes only when PresentMon enabled.

implementation: Explicit LCONNECT_MANGOHUD_PER_FRAME_LOG absolute file opt-in; no directory/newest-game guessing or game/config changes. Supports researched16-column schema, requires producer log_interval=0 capture contract.

Skip historical rows on attach/reset/replacement. Mean N*1000/sum(frame_ms) of newly appended complete frames; positive finite reciprocal fps/frametime and increasing elapsed required. This is logged-frame mean, not a claimed HWiNFO-equivalent statistic.

Regular no-follow/nonblocking open rejects FIFO; header8KiB/batch256KiB/line1024bytes bounds. No new bytes ->unavailable; malformed/replayed/overflow rows revoke values. Source ID binds canonical path/dev/inode; replacement changes ID and does not retarget saved widget.

FramesPerSecond unit in shared sensor catalog and LCD/theme consumers. Pure Mini renderer has explicit FPS source, EN/RU formatting, duplicate/unit/freshness/missing rejection and no CPU/GPU-default fallback. Both adapters expose/select/persist FPS source ID.

expanded_cache_ipc_lcd_jpeg.result: 50.00 FPS from10ms+30ms frames; stale JPEG differs and recovery restores exact JPEG

checks.gnome_private_preferences: passed GTK FPS source/Save/readback, existing draft/stale/reset/EN-RU/persistence/reaping checks
checks.gnome_runtime: private extracted GJS1.90.1; candidate package metadata51, not support qualification
checks.strict_locale_check: 790/790 English keys;0missing;65dynamic outputs remain to qualify

coverage: Existing benchmark warmup, harmonic duration mean rather than arithmetic FPS, no unchanged-data freshness, reset/sleep warmup.
Partial/malformed/replayed rows, invalid numbers/units, backlog limit, schema mismatch, symlink/FIFO/relative-path rejection, file replacement identity.
Real collector/cache/IPC/LCD JPEG with FPS, Fahrenheit independence, stale and exact recovery without theme edit.
Node FPS explicit/null source, no shared default fallback, duplicate/unit/invalid/stale/identity replacement and EN/RU rendering.
Qt keyboard FPS selection/retention and private GTK FPS source Save/readback with actual toolkit models and signals.
limits: Full capture enable/disable/configuration UI and runtime ownership remain. Env config is an opt-in source, not complete Windows PresentMon workflow.
Actual producer mode/completeness cannot be proven from the CSV alone; nonzero log_interval is unsupported.
Windows aggregation window/PresentMon equivalence, real game identity/focus automation, supported MangoHud release matrix and actual capture IO cost remain.
Stalled filesystem/cancellation/rotation/inode reuse/sleep/resource fault matrix, complete shell sessions/accessibility and combined LCD workload remain.
No game/hardware/capture qualification from synthetic metrics. Gamescope compositor FPS and instantaneous CSV fps were not substituted for presented average.
